## Profile catalog contribution

- [ ] I added or updated `catalog/packages/<game-id>.json`.
- [ ] The package contains no secrets, shell code, download tokens, or absolute paths.
- [ ] I incremented the package `version` when changing an existing profile.
- [ ] I ran `uv run --no-project --with jsonschema python3 scripts/build-profile-catalog.py`.
- [ ] I ran `uv run --no-project --with jsonschema python3 scripts/build-profile-catalog.py --check`.
- [ ] I tested the profile against a server installation I control, or clearly marked what remains untested below.
